about: What the scrubbed export of HS2Next ships (include) and leaves out (exclude); read by Tools/leak_check.py (row LeakCheck). Paths are relative to the project, '/' separated, case-insensitive; '*' and '?' stay inside one folder, '**' crosses folders (as in Tools/test_areas.json). A path is exported when an include pattern matches and no exclude pattern does; an include pattern without wildcards (one named file) wins over the exclude globs. Every tracked path must be named by one side (leak_check.py --manifest-coverage). 'why' gives the reason of every pattern.

why.Assets/HS2Next/**: the application, its Editor tests, shaders, fonts, settings and resources
why.Assets/HS2Next.meta: the folder's meta file (Unity keeps the folder's GUID in it)
why.Assets/Compat/**: the receiving stubs: type and field names generated from the bundles' TypeTrees by Tools/gen_compat_stubs.py, no code (THIRD_PARTY.md, 'Names used for interoperability')
why.Assets/Plugins/Compat/**: the receiving stubs of the plugin assemblies (generated as Assets/Compat)
why.Assets/UniversalRenderPipelineGlobalSett: URP's global settings asset that ProjectSettings/GraphicsSettings.asset names; needed to open the project
its meta file (the GUID GraphicsSettings refers to)
why.Assets/DefaultVolumeProfile.asset: URP's default volume profile named by the global settings
why.Packages/manifest.json: the Unity packages the project uses (fetched by the Package Manager, not copied)
why.ProjectSettings/**: needed to open the project; checked for machine data (none: no paths, no cloud or organisation ids; companyName stp3 and the application icon)
why.Config/settings.example.json: every settings key the runtime reads, with its comment line; users copy it to settings.local.json
why.Tests/**: test inputs: save-format goldens and fixtures, scene-model fixtures, the route reference values, the pose library's aggregate census (numbers only, no file names); the loader's test plugins and their tests (Tests/Plugins, CC0)
why.Samples/**: the sample plugins (CC0; outside Assets, built with dotnet): the starting point of plugin authors
why.Tools/unity_batch.ps1: the shared Unity batch runner every row and build goes through
why.Tools/mono_tests/**: the entry points and the content stub of the plain-Mono suites
why.Tools/offline_compile.py: the compile check without Unity that runs before Unity jobs
why.Tools/hs2n_bridge.py: the client of the automation bridge (player checks, external scripts)
why.Tools/plugin_player_check.py: the player row PluginCheck.player (the sample plugin in the app player)
why.Tools/maker_session.py: the opt-in player row MakerSession.player (the one-hour Maker session over the bridge, numbers only)
why.Tools/perf_player_check.py: the opt-in player measurements PF1-PF9 and the UnloadUnusedAssets cost
why.Tools/allcards_player.py: the whole-suite player row AllCards.player (every card built once in the app player; numbers only)
why.Tools/mod_sweep_report.py: the mod sweep's work list from the zipmod scan cache and its failure report (rows ModSweepTest / ModSweep.player; numbers and zipmod file names only)
why.Tools/mod_sweep_player.py: the mod sweep's player pass ModSweep.player (rows that ended an Editor process, added one by one in the app player)
why.Tools/mod_sweep_player_rows.txt: the fixed input of the player pass ModSweep.player (Studio item rows that once ended an Editor process; ids only)
why.Tools/player_launch_audit.py: a static check that every player start in Tools/ gives the player its own UserData folder (with a self-test)
why.Tools/make_icon.py: draws the application icon from simple shapes (deterministic, standard library only)
why.Tools/package_dist.ps1: assembles the distribution folder from the tested app build by an allow-list copy, checks it for leaks and optionally zips it with its SHA-256
why.Tools/noargs_check.py: the bare-exe row PlayerBuild.noargs (a plain copy of the distribution started without arguments on a scratch data root: folders, token, readiness, quit)
why.Tools/firstrun_check.py: the first-run rows FirstRun.player / FirstRun.cold (the setup guide walked over the bridge on a clean data root)
why.Tools/startup_check.py: the start-up row Startup.player (cold and warm start-up and quit times of the app player; numbers only)
why.Tools/update_check_test.py: the update check row UpdateCheck.play (the app against a local release server: the dialog at start, skip, by hand latest / failure, the request headers; never GitHub)
why.Tools/ime_caret_check.py: the opt-in IME caret check with real OS input (the caret after a conversion with both Japanese text services; the test plugin Tests/Plugins/ImeProbe); not a row of run_tests.ps1
why.Tools/dist/**: the distribution package texts (README in en / ja / zh-Hans), its file list and allow-list, and the binary string scan of the staged folder
why.Tools/session_items.json: the Studio item groups and categories the Maker session draws from (numbers and names of the game's lists)
why.Tools/session_gate.json: the local machine's process names that stop the long GPU runs (per machine, not exported)
why.Tools/plugins.ps1: builds, stages and verifies plugins (the sample, the test plugins)
why.Tools/gen_commands_md.py: writes the command reference Reference/COMMANDS.md from a help dump (row CommandsDoc checks it)
why.Tools/texguard_repair.py: the cross-check of the app's texture check, and the repaired bundle copies of earlier runs
why.Tools/make_texcheck_fixtures.py: writes the texture check's synthetic test bundles (Editor/Fixtures/TextureCheck; no game asset)
why.Tools/texcheck_prescan.ps1: runs the app headless to fill the texture verdict cache ahead of a first session
why.Tools/gen_compat_stubs.py: build: generates Assets/Compat and Assets/Plugins/Compat from the TypeTree scan of the user's own install
why.Tools/typetree_scan.py: build: the TypeTree scan gen_compat_stubs.py reads
why.Tools/gen_legacy_shaders.py: build: generates the legacy shader family of Assets/HS2Next/Shaders
why.Tools/hs2card.py: the card reader of the census scripts the runner calls
why.Tools/route_reference.py: writes Tests/Routes/route_reference.json from the formulas (independent of the C# evaluator)
why.Tools/shape_measure.py: the black-box measurement of the shape sliders (talks to a measurement build of an HS2-side bridge plugin with the shape commands; that build is not part of HS2Next)
why.Tools/shape_fit.py: the fit of the shape tables from the measurement
why.Tools/survey/maker_clothes_census.py: run by run_tests.ps1 before the clothes play rows (the thumbnail guard records)
why.Tools/survey/maker_accessories_census.py: run by run_tests.ps1 before the accessory play rows (the thumbnail guard records)
why.Tools/survey/loose_png_census.py: run by run_tests.ps1 in the row LooseTextureTest
why.Tools/survey/maker_core_census.py: imported by the census scripts above
why.Tools/survey/maker_hair_census.py: imported by the census scripts above
why.Tools/survey/shadowed_bundle_census.py: imported by the census scripts above
why.Tools/survey/shape/fit_report.md: the record of the shape-table fit (Tools/shape_fit.py): how the shape tables were derived from measurements
why.Tools/survey/shape/shape_body_map.approx: the body shape table as first approximated from the measurement
why.Tools/survey/shape/shape_remaps.fitted.t: the fitted remaps of the shape tables
why.Tools/leak_allow.json: the leak check's allow-list (generic hits only; never private tokens)
why.Tools/README_*.md: how to run the tests and tools
why.THIRD_PARTY.md: third-party software and the names used for interoperability
why.CLEANROOM.md: how the code was written (behaviour only, black-box fits, data facts)
why.README.md: what HS2Next is, how to install, start and build it, the terms (English)
why.ARCHITECTURE.md: how the application is built: content, save format, rendering, motion, UI, bridge, plugins, tests
why.CHANGELOG.md: the released versions and what changed
why.CONTRIBUTING.md: how to build and test, and the rules for contributions
why.Reference/**: reference documents: the bridge commands (generated by Tools/gen_commands_md.py) and the plugin guide
why.Tools/targets.example.json: the committed form of the test targets: copy it to Tools/targets.json and fill in cards of your install
why.Tools/api/**: the frozen public surface of the Api assemblies and the commands (row ApiSurfaceTest compares against it)
why..gitignore: keeps generated and local files out of the new history
why..gitattributes: line-ending and binary rules of the repository
why.Plugins/**: the Editor's plugin folder (staged copies of built plugins, git-ignored)
why.Tools/targets.json: the test targets: cards of the local install (per machine; Tools/targets.example.json is the committed form)
why.Config/leak_tokens.local.txt: the leak check's private tokens (local only, git-ignored)
why.*.csproj: generated by Unity at the project root (the plugin projects under Samples and Tests are written by hand and exported)
why.*.slnx: generated by Unity at the project root
